openapi: 3.0.0 info: title: Precision Pulley & Idler Open API description: |- This is a general Open API to expose data and endpoints to do business with Precision Pulley & Idler
This is an OAS 3.0 special conversion for Salesforce. contact: email: wteeter@ppi-global.com version: 1.4.1 servers: - url: https://dev-precision-open-api.azurewebsites.net/ - url: https://prod-precision-open-api.azurewebsites.net/ security: - api_auth: [] paths: /order: put: tags: - Order summary: Create an order description: |- This creates an order in the PPI system. If any exception to order processing is encountered after being ingested, a PPI representative will contact the order requester via the input payload's `contactName`
Regarding purchase orders, `purchaseOrder.number` is always required. `purchaseOrder.url` will be used if available, otherwise submit `purchaseOrder.documentType` and `purchaseOrder.document`, the latter of which is a base64 encoded document. If all three are submitted, `purchaseOrder.url` will be used and the other two parameters are ignored. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order' responses: '202': description: Order was dispatched for processing content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: message: type: string '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" /order/salesforce/{externalID}/invoice: get: tags: - Order summary: Retrieve an invoice document description: |- This returns a base64 encoded PDF document.
Same result and logic as /order/{orderNumber}/{orderDate}/invoice. Modified to handle SalesForce's external ID as one path parameter parameters: - in: path name: externalID required: true schema: type: string description: Should be in the format '<orderNumber><orderDate>' where orderNumber is zero padded to six digits responses: '200': description: Invoice found and returned content: application/pdf: schema: type: string format: binary application/json: schema: type: object properties: invoicePDF: type: string format: base64 '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" '404': description: Invoice not found content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' /order/{orderNumber}/{orderDate}/invoice: get: tags: - Order summary: Retrieve an invoice document description: This returns a base64 encoded PDF document parameters: - in: path name: orderNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderNumber" - in: path name: orderDate required: true schema: type: string format: date responses: '200': description: Invoice found and returned content: application/pdf: schema: type: string format: binary application/json: schema: type: object properties: invoicePDF: type: string format: base64 '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" '404': description: Invoice not found content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' /item/{itemNumber}/inventory: get: tags: - Item summary: Retrieves inventory information for one item description: |- Do **_not_** use this endpoint to determine if a collection of items with a non-null `quantityAvailableToAssemble` can come out of one warehouse. Use `/availableToAssemble` for this purpose. An explanation can be found in the description of that endpoint.
This will return an array of objects where each object holds the availability of the item as well as the warehouse where that availability exists.
`quantityAvailable` will be `null` iff `quantityAvailableToAssemble` is not `null`, and `quantityAvailableToAssemble` will be `null` iff `quantityAvailable` is not `null`. This is true across all warehouses for any particular item. parameters: - in: path name: itemNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber" responses: '200': description: Successful operation content: application/json: schema: type: array items: type: object properties: warehouse: $ref: "#/components/schemas/Warehouse" quantityAvailable: type: integer quantityAvailableToAssemble: type: integer example: - quantityAvailable: 0 quantityAvailableToAssemble: null warehouse: id: "1" name: Pella address: contact: null street1: 300 S.E. 14TH STREET street2: P.O. BOX 287 city: PELLA state: IA zip: 50219 - quantityAvailable: 0 quantityAvailableToAssemble: null warehouse: id: "U" name: Midwest Service Center address: contact: null street1: 2254 AVENUE OF INDUSTRY street2: "" city: CORNING state: IA zip: 50841 '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" /item/{itemNumber}/pricing/{customerNumber}: get: tags: - Item summary: Returns pricing on an item for the specified PPI customer description: |- Selling price is returned here. If the `sellingPrice` is `null`, we are not able to offer pricing with this method.
If many items require price to be checked, up to 75 items can be checked simultaneously with the `POST /item/pricing` endpoint. parameters: - in: path name: itemNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber" - in: path name: customerNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomerNumber" - in: query name: indirectCustomerID required: false description: Optional indirect customer to determine pricing for. Reference `/customer/{customerNumber}` for a list of indirect customers. schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/IndirectCustomerID" responses: '200': description: Successful operation content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: itemNuumber: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber" listPrice: type: number sellPrice: type: number nullable: true '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" '404': description: Item not found content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest" /item/pricing/{customerNumber}: post: tags: - Item summary: Returns pricing for a list of items description: |- This is a `POST` route due to the potential amount of data required to be sent with this endpoint. No creation or modification of data happens with this route. It is effectively a `GET` with a payload.
This has the same usage as `/item/{itemNumber}/pricing/{customerNumber}`, but can be used to derive pricing once for many items.
If `sellingPrice` is `null`, we are not able to offer pricing with this method.
The number of items is capped at 75 items per request. If more than 75 are sent, the endpoint will return an error 400.
If there was an error getting pricing for an item, it will not be returned in the `items` array, but rather an error message will be placed in the `errors` array parameters: - in: path name: customerNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomerNumber" requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: array maxItems: 75 items: type: object properties: itemNumber: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber"
responses: '200': description: Successful operation content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: errors: type: array items: type: "string" items: type: array items: properties: itemNumber: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber" listPrice: type: number sellPrice: type: number nullable: true '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" /availableToAssemble: post: tags: - Item summary: Determines if the items passed can be fulfilled with one order description: |- This is a `POST` route due to the potential amount of data required to be sent with this endpoint. No creation or modification of data happens with this route. It is effectively a `GET` with a payload.
Some PPI product is stocked as components which are assembled upon order. There can be cases where two different PPI products share the same sub-component so the independent `/item/{itemNumber}/inventory` check isn't sufficient for more than one assembled item.
This endpoint takes in a list of PPI products and determines if a PPI warehouse can fulfill all products from at least one warehouse. If PPI can fulfill all products, the warehouses that are eligible for fulfillment are also returned here.
If a non-assembled component is passed here, the endpoint will check the individual's availability (not availability to assemble) which is the same as the value from `/item/{itemNumber}/inventory`. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: shippingAddress: $ref: "#/components/schemas/Address" items: type: array items: type: object properties: itemNumber: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemNumber" quantity: type: number
responses: '200': description: Successful operation content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: canFulfill: type: boolean fulfillmentWarehouses: type: array items: $ref: "#/components/schemas/Warehouse" '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" /contact/{customerNumber}/{email}: put: tags: - Contacts summary: Upserts contact information description: Upserts contact information parameters: - in: path name: customerNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomerNumber" - in: path name: email required: true schema: type: string format: email
requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: name: type: string maxLength: 30 responses: '201': description: Contact was successfully updated or created content: application/json: schema: type: string '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest' '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" /customer/{customerNumber}: get: tags: - Customer summary: Information about a PPI customer parameters: - in: path name: customerNumber required: true schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomerNumber" responses: '200': description: Successful operation content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/Customer" '400': description: Invalid request input received content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest" '401': description: Unauthorized to endpoint content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnauthorizedRequest" '404': description: Customer not found content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvalidRequest" components: securitySchemes: api_auth: type: apiKey in: header name: x-api-key schemas: Address: type: object properties: contact: type: string street1: type: string street2: type: string city: type: string state: type: string zip: type: string DefaultResponse: type: object properties: statusCode: description: HTTP status code.
